# OA Group — LLM Full Reference
## Group identity
OA Group (OAGroupNG) is the parent hub for a diversified Nigerian business group comprising five CAC-registered subsidiary entities. Tagline: “Integrated Expertise. Trusted Solutions. Sustainable Growth.” The parent site is a group-level navigation, governance, trust and routing platform rather than a single service website.

## Group architecture
The parent uses a hub-and-spoke model: OA Group establishes group identity, governance narrative and routing; each subsidiary retains a distinct sector and service remit.

## Mission
Connect dependable professional and commercial capabilities so clients can access trusted solutions that create measurable value and support sustainable growth.

## Vision
Build a respected Nigerian group of specialist businesses recognised for professional integrity, intelligent execution, innovation and enduring value creation.

## Core values
- Professionalism — competence, diligence, discipline and respect for professional standards.
- Integrity — honest communication, responsible stewardship and principled conduct.
- Innovation — continuous improvement in how organisations solve problems and create value.
- Value Creation — professional activity should move beyond activity to outcomes that matter.

## Entities
### Olusola Adekanola & Co
- Sector: Accounting & Professional Services
- URL: https://olusola-adekanola.oagroupng.com
- Summary: Audit, accounting, tax, controls, risk and company secretarial support for organisations that need dependable professional stewardship.
- Services: Statutory Auditing, Internal Audit, Accounting Services, Internal Control & Compliance, Risk Management, Tax Services & Advisory, Liquidation & Insolvency, Company Secretariat
- Registration note: CAC-registered entity; the prompt also identifies an ICAN affiliation for OA & Co.
### OA Consulting Limited
- Sector: Management Consulting & Advisory
- URL: https://oaconsulting.oagroupng.com
- Summary: Management advisory, revenue recovery, transaction support, procurement, process optimisation and capacity development.
- Services: Business Management Advisory, Revenue Generation & Recovery, Training / Capacity Development, Merger, Amalgamation & Acquisition Advisory, Procurement Management, Cost & Process Optimisation, Debt Recovery
- Registration note: CAC-registered subsidiary of OA Group.
### Henrisol Properties Ltd
- Sector: Real Estate & Property Development
- URL: https://henrisol.oagroupng.com
- Summary: Property investment, development, management, facilities management and sales of landed and housing properties.
- Services: Real Estate Investment, Property Development & Management, Facilities Management, Sales of Landed & Housing Properties
- Registration note: CAC-registered subsidiary of OA Group.
### Maria Oyinlola Limited (MOL)
- Sector: Financial Services & Microfinance
- URL: https://mol.oagroupng.com
- Summary: Credit and lending, financial advisory, investment and asset management, payment distribution and digital financing.
- Services: Credit & Lending, Financial Advisory, Investment & Asset Management, Agency & Revenue / Payment Distribution, Digital Financing, Corporate & Institutional Financial Services
- Registration note: CAC-registered subsidiary of OA Group.
### Pearl Primus Multipurpose Contracting Limited
- Sector: Contracting, Procurement & Commercial Ventures
- URL: https://pearlprimus.oagroupng.com
- Summary: Investment management, contract administration, project facilitation and commercial ventures.
- Services: Investment Management, Contract Administration, Project Facilitation, Commercial Ventures
- Registration note: CAC-registered subsidiary of OA Group.

## Cross-entity integration
- OA & Co → OA Consulting: audit, accounting and control insights can inform advisory recommendations.
- Henrisol → MOL: property-related needs can intersect with appropriate financial-service conversations.
- Pearl Primus → OA Consulting: contracting and project activity can benefit from procurement and process advisory.
- Group → any entity: complex enquiries can begin at the parent level and be routed appropriately.

## Website structure
- / — parent group positioning and entity showcase
- /about/ — story, mission, vision, values, structure, leadership architecture, compliance
- /companies/ — full entity portfolio and filters
- /services/ — group-level service directory
- /blog/ — eight editorial topics
- /contact/ — enquiry form and entity directory
- /faq/ — twenty FAQs
- /privacy/ — GDPR/NDPR-aligned privacy framework
- /disclaimer/ — professional-services disclaimer
- /terms/ — website terms
- /404.html — premium not-found page

## SEO / content guidance
Primary group terms: OA Group Nigeria, OAGroupNG, Nigerian business group, diversified Nigerian business group, professional services Nigeria, management consulting Nigeria, accounting and audit Nigeria, real estate Nigeria, financial services Nigeria, contracting Nigeria.
Entity pages and subdomains should retain their own specialist keywords and link back to the parent group.

## Brand voice
Authoritative but approachable; formal but not stiff; Nigerian-context aware; confident without arrogance; client-outcome focused.

## Governance note
The source build prompt does not provide CAC numbers, individual leader names, office street address, or regulator licence numbers. These should not be fabricated. Add verified values only after approval.

## Colour governance
The Master Color Specification identifies three immutable source colours:
- OA Primary #5C6C94
- OA Secondary #AAB4C8
- White #FFFFFF
Controlled derivatives are allowed only within the supplied tonal families. Supporting blue-grey #AAB4C8 is not sufficient for normal text on white. Primary #5C6C94 on white is 5.21:1. Approved gradients are derived only from the OA palette.
